name: Mercy USA for Aid and Development
mission: Mercy-USA for Aid and Development is dedicated to alleviating human suffering and supporting individuals and their communities in their efforts to become more self-sufficient. Our philosophy is "Helping People Help Themselves".  Incorporated in the State of Michigan in 1988, Mercy-USA's projects focus on improving health, nutrition and access to safe water, as well as promoting economic and educational growth and providing disaster relief around the world.

rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 1988, Mercy-USA for Aid and Development is a humanitarian organization that provides critical health, nutrition, and water services to vulnerable populations. The charity operates across several crisis-affected regions, including Somalia, Syria, and Gaza. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="1">$34,922,507 in total revenue</cite> to fund its relief and development programs. This represents a <cite id="2">35% decline in revenue</cite> from the previous fiscal year. Despite this decrease in funding, the organization maintains a <cite id="3">92.3/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting strong accountability and leadership. Mercy-USA is <cite id="4">explicitly zakat-eligible</cite>, directing funds to categories such as the poor (fuqara) and needy (masakin). Their operational model focuses on direct service delivery, which includes <cite id="5">maintaining an 80% TB cure rate</cite> in Somalia and building <cite id="6">950 modular shelters</cite> for displaced families. While the <cite id="7">program expense ratio is 96.3%</cite> based on total filings, the organization's <cite id="8">cash-adjusted program ratio is 93%</cite>. This high adjusted ratio indicates that the charity is efficient in directing its liquid resources toward its core mission of saving lives and improving health outcomes.
